subject: Animation
title: He-Man and the Toy-Cartoon Pipeline
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: He-Man and the Toy-Cartoon Pipeline.

hook.text: In 1983, He-Man premiered as the first TV cartoon explicitly created to sell an existing toy line.

buildup.text: Mattel financed the show as a 22-minute daily commercial for Masters of the Universe action figures.

discovery.text: The FCC had just deregulated children's television, allowing shows to function as product advertisements.

twist.text: Parents and critics were furious, but the strategy worked. Toy sales exploded across the industry.

climax.text: He-Man launched the toy-cartoon pipeline that produced Transformers, G.I. Joe, and dozens of imitators.

punchline.text: A cartoon to sell toys changed how all kids' shows were made.

quiz.question: Why was He-Man's premiere significant for the animation industry?
options: It was the first cartoon animated by computer
It was the first TV cartoon explicitly created to sell an existing toy line, launching the toy-cartoon pipeline
It was the first animated series aimed at adult viewers
